name: Tlalocan Theophany
source:
The Two Realms were never separate.  The Earth and the Air. The Fire and the Water. Their differences are the very weaving that forms the robes of our golden King, the Sun... 

The corpse looks back.  Its eyes are perpetually closed.  It may not even have eyes. Or a body. Even so, its gaze is far too haunting. And in the reflection cast upon your portrait, it becomes ever more Real. You must take responsibility for bringing  them onto the world.  Even if you deny yourself its warmth, They deserve the Light. ...
